children: Overview
UK neonatal intensive care device maker's half-year revenue fell due to prior period one-off contracts
SLE product revenues grew 38% yr/yr excluding one-off export contracts
Outlook
Inspiration Healthcare expects to close the financial year slightly ahead of company-compiled market expectations
Company enters second half with confidence and a strong orderbook
Result Drivers
SLE PRODUCT GROWTH - SLE product revenues rose 38% yr/yr excluding prior period one-off export contracts, reflecting continued demand for core neonatal intensive care products
AIRION SALES - Airon revenues increased by 40% to £1.6 mln, driven by an initial order under a three-year purchasing agreement with a large US healthcare provider
MEDTECH DISTRIBUTION - MedTech distribution revenues grew 7% yr/yr, contributing to overall revenue growth
